title: Biased Agents, Extreme Beliefs: Motivated Reasoning Under Competing Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.22446v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: People often face environments where multiple models compete to explain the same observations. This paper examines how people update beliefs in such settings and how preferences over payoff-relevant states shape model selection and belief updating. This paper first develops a framework where preference-driven bias distorts the perceived model, affecting Bayesian and best-fit updating differently. In a laboratory experiment, most participants are classified as Bayesian updaters, who average across models, while a substantial minority are classified as best-fit updaters, who select the model that best fits the observed signal. Within-participant comparisons between the symmetric payoff and asymmetric payoff conditions indicate that asymmetric payoffs shift reported beliefs toward the preferred state, particularly among participants classified as best-fit updaters. translated_title: 偏差代理人，极端信念：竞争模型下的动机性推理
translated_abstract: 人们常常面临多个模型竞争解释同一观察结果的环境。本文研究了人们在这种环境下如何更新信念，以及与收益相关状态的偏好如何影响模型选择和信念更新。本文首先建立了一个框架，其中偏好驱动的偏差会扭曲所感知的模型，从而以不同方式影响贝叶斯更新和最优拟合更新。在一项实验室实验中，大多数参与者被归类为贝叶斯更新者，他们对多个模型进行平均；而相当一部分少数参与者被归类为最优拟合更新者，他们选择最能拟合观察信号的模型。对称收益与非对称收益条件下的被试内比较表明，非对称收益使报告的信念向偏好状态偏移，尤其是在被归类为最优拟合更新者的参与者中。相对于对称收益，非对称收益增加了报告的信念（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了一个偏好驱动偏差扭曲模型感知的理论框架，并通过实验发现多数人采用跨模型平均的贝叶斯更新、少数人采用最优拟合更新，且非对称收益会使信念向偏好状态偏移，这一效应在最优拟合更新者中尤为显著。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a framework in which preference-driven bias distorts the perceived model and shows experimentally that most people are Bayesian updaters who average across models while a minority are best-fit updaters, with asymmetric payoffs shifting beliefs toward preferred states, especially among best-fit updaters.
